subject: POC planning: KastTech latency & throughput KPIs + timeline
summary: Post-discovery follow-up establishing PoC acceptance criteria (latency, throughput, cost/token, quality), owners, timeline, and immediate next steps for a two-week trial with KastTech.
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@kasttech.com>, Samir Raza <samir@kasttech.com>
Cc: Sergio Alvarez <sergio_alvarez@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 09:15:00 +01:00
Subject: POC planning: KastTech latency & throughput KPIs + timeline

Hi Marta / Samir — great to meet today. Quick recap and proposed plan so we have a single place to land on scope, success criteria, owners, and next steps. Please reply with any edits or confirm and we’ll lock dates.

Scope (what we’ll exercise)
- Inference for KastTech’s customer-support semantic search + short-response generation path (max prompt length ~1,024 tokens).
- Target workload: baseline traffic simulator we discussed (~2 requests/sec sustained, 8 reqs/sec burst).
- Data: KastTech will provide a redacted sample set (500 representative prompts + expected ground-truth replies).

POC length & timeline
- Proposed trial window: 2026-03-22 -> 2026-04-05 (2 weeks).
- Kickoff/integration window: 2026-03-16 -> 2026-03-19 (network + API keys + sample data ingestion).

Success criteria / KPIs (we recommend measuring these during steady-state periods and peak burst)
- Latency: p95 <= 200 ms for inference (model variant: rdx-small-8q).
- Throughput: sustain 2 rps with <5% error rate; tolerate 8 rps short bursts for up to 2 minutes.
- Cost: blended inference cost <= $0.0006 per token (target – we’ll provide breakdown).
- Quality: intent-match >= 92% and average BLEU/ROUGE-type quality metric on the 500-sample test set (we’ll run the eval harness and share results).
- Reliability: <1% 5xx rate and automatic fallback to smaller-latency variant under stress.

Ownership (who does what)
- KastTech: deliver sample prompts, expected outputs, and provide test account for network validation (Marta / Samir).
- Redwood: provide API keys, sample client integration, run baseline and load tests, and produce final PoC report with KPI charts (Vanessa & Sergio).
- SRE/Network: Jonas will coordinate any firewall/IP allowlists and provide connection test script.

Attachments we’ll share now:
- poc-checklist.xlsx (integration steps + data checklist)
- network-security-questionnaire.pdf (we’ll need this back filled)
- redwood-poc-template.docx (report template we’ll deliver at the end)

Immediate next steps
1) Marta: confirm you can deliver the 500-sample set by 2026-03-18.
2) Samir: confirm the preferred trial start date (we suggested 2026-03-22).
3) KastTech / IT: share allowlist IPs or let Jonas know to coordinate.
4) Redwood: Vanessa/Sergio will provision keys and internal test beds by 2026-03-15.

If that looks good I’ll send a brief kickoff calendar invite and a DocuSign for the standard PoC terms. Thanks — excited to get this running.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
+1 415 555 0192

Attachment: network-security-questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Marta Lopez <marta.lopez@kasttech.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Samir Raza <samir@kasttech.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Mar 2026 10:02:00 +01:00
Subject: Re: POC planning: KastTech latency & throughput KPIs + timeline

Thanks Vanessa — and thanks everyone for the time today. This looks good overall; a couple clarifications from our side: 

- We can deliver the 500-sample prompts by 2026-03-18 but they will need light anonymization (we’ll drop user IDs). Is that sufficient for your quality eval?
- Can you include a simple per-token cost breakdown and an estimate for typical weekly spend at target load? Samir is primarily interested in unit economics.
- On security: we’ve got an internal compliance checkpoint on 2026-03-17 — can you confirm you have SOC 2 Type II docs and an incident response contact? We’ve attached our questionnaire; please mark any sections that will need legal review.

For timeline: 2026-03-22 start works for us if integration completes the prior week. Can you confirm when we’ll get keys so our engineers can validate calls?

I’ll also loop in our infra lead if Jonas needs to coordinate on IPs.

— Marta
Marta Lopez
Head of Product | KastTech
marta.lopez@kasttech.com
Attachment: kasttech-security-questionnaire-filled-template.docx (not attached here — we’ll upload to your Drive after the compliance checkpoint)

Subject: Re: POC planning: KastTech latency & throughput KPIs + timeline

Vanessa — quick internal sync based on Marta’s note. 

- Keys: I’ll provision a scoped trial API key (rate-limited to the requested baseline) by 2026-03-15 EOD. Will include usage dashboard access so Samir can watch tokens/costs in near real time.
- Eval harness: Laura, can you own running the 500-sample quality run (intent-match + quality metrics) and produce the baseline report by 2026-03-26 (end of week 1 of the trial)?
- Network: Jonas, please confirm the 3 IPs we will need to be allowlisted and provide a simple curl test for KastTech IT to run.

I’ll also draft the minimal PoC SOW (one page) and attach it to the DocuSign — Vanessa, if you want to review before I send, I’ll ping you.

Sergio
